Spannendes Erlebnismuseum zur über 115-jährigen Geschichte des Tiroler Steinöls

kurzbeschreibung: The Vitalberg experience center in Pertisau presents the history, extraction, and benefits of healing Tiroler Steinöl.
beschreibung:
The Black Gold of Achensee

At Vitalberg in Pertisau, everything revolves around the famous Tiroler Steinöl, extracted from the oil shale of the Karwendelgebirge for over a century. The distinctive glass pyramid on the lakeshore houses an interactive exhibition on the tradition of mining and the versatile healing properties of this natural product.

Tradition and Well-Being by the Lake

During a tour, visitors learn how Martin Albrecht discovered the healing oil in 1902 and how it continues to be gently processed today. Afterwards, the cozy café with its sunny terrace invites guests to enjoy the wonderful view of Achensee.
